title: Normalized cyclic Hom transport for native compact support
statement: Fix a finite-field datum $D$, a prime $\ell\ne D.p$, model spaces $X,Y$ and a separated quasi-compact locally finite-type morphism $f_0:X.base\to Y.base$ as in [def-sf-native-exceptional-forgetful-data]. Write $P_X,P_Y$ for the actual native Frobenius functors and $J$ for nativeShriek. Take the compactification $c_0$ used by J itself and its ordinary native-adic composite $O=Rp_*j_!$. Let $\alpha:J;U_Y\cong U_X;O$ be the restriction of compactificationComparison from [lem-sf-native-weil-open-proper-forgetting], with U denoting derived native-adic forgetting before closure and section transport. For native Weil complexes $K,H$ and integer r put $\tau_r(v)=\alpha_K;O(v);\sigma_{r,U_XH};\alpha_H^{-1}[r]$, using O's canonical shift comparison. Given normalized natural boundary families $b_X,b_Y$ of [def-sf-cyclic-derived-hom-data], without requiring exactness, one has $\tau_r(T_Xv)=T_Y\tau_r(v)$ in every degree, $\tau_0(\operatorname{forget}(v))=\operatorname{forget}(Jv)$ for every native v, and $J(b_X([v]))=b_Y([\tau_{-1}(v)])$ for every ordinary degree-minus-one v. All boundary maps use the boundedness witnesses of the native Weil complexes. No exceptional adjoint, counit or Hom bijectivity is asserted.

theorem counitHomTransport_compatible
    (bX : CyclicDerivedHomBoundary (WeilSheaf.frobeniusPullback D.k₀ l X.base.left))
    (bY : CyclicDerivedHomBoundary (WeilSheaf.frobeniusPullback D.k₀ l Y.base.left))
    (hbX : CyclicDerivedHomBoundaryNatural _ bX ∧ CyclicDerivedHomBoundaryNormalized _ bX)
    (hbY : CyclicDerivedHomBoundaryNatural _ bY ∧ CyclicDerivedHomBoundaryNormalized _ bY)
    (K H : W D l X) :
    (∀ r v, counitHomTransport D l f₀ K H r
        (cyclicDerivedHomAction _ K.obj H.obj r v) =
      cyclicDerivedHomAction _ ((nativeShriek D l f₀).obj K).obj
        ((nativeShriek D l f₀).obj H).obj r (counitHomTransport D l f₀ K H r v)) ∧
    (∀ v : K ⟶ H, counitHomTransport D l f₀ K H 0
        (cyclicDerivedForget _ K.obj H.obj v.hom) =
      cyclicDerivedForget _ ((nativeShriek D l f₀).obj K).obj
        ((nativeShriek D l f₀).obj H).obj ((nativeShriek D l f₀).map v).hom) ∧
    (∀ v : CyclicDerivedHom (WeilSheaf.frobeniusPullback D.k₀ l X.base.left)
        K.obj H.obj (-1),
      ((nativeShriek D l f₀).map (ObjectProperty.homMk
        (bX K.obj H.obj K.property.1 H.property.1 (QuotientAddGroup.mk v)))).hom =
      bY ((nativeShriek D l f₀).obj K).obj ((nativeShriek D l f₀).obj H).obj
        ((nativeShriek D l f₀).obj K).property.1 ((nativeShriek D l f₀).obj H).property.1
        (QuotientAddGroup.mk (counitHomTransport D l f₀ K H (-1) v)))
